name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: A list of actions that opens from a button.
a11y: role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items.
Arrow keys move, Enter and Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus, type-ahead jumps to an item.
The trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.
usage:
import {Button, DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger} from '@monoline/react';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button>Actions</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Entry</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Rename</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Duplicate</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem tone="danger">Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
